name: Prompt
description: Collects multi-line input for AI and chat interfaces.
propsSummary: placeholder: string (default: Ask, Search or Chat...)

onFiles.description: Called with files added by the attach button, a paste, or a drop anywhere on the card. Providing it enables all three.

accept.description: accept filter for the attach button's picker, e.g. "image/*"

appearance.description: How the card is divided up. "panel" keeps the toolbar as a filled footer under a rule; "seamless" makes the whole card one writing surface with the controls floating on it.

when: Multi-line input with a submit action
Toolbars carrying attachments or a model picker
whenNot: Search-only fields (use Input with the search variant)
guidelines: Set loading while the request is in flight to block duplicate sends
Prompt.Textarea forwards native textarea props and composes your own handlers
appearance="seamless" floats the controls on the writing surface instead of a footer
Seamless secondary controls stay transparent; only Prompt.Submit keeps a filled shape
Prompt.Submit uses a neutral inverse surface, never semantic brand color
Prompt.ModeButton toggles a setting; Prompt.Select picks one from a list
Wire onFiles once — the attach button, paste, and drop all route through it
Render Prompt.Attachments above Prompt.Textarea; they are part of the message

examples.name: Basic
examples.description: A textarea and a submit button, nothing else.

examples.name: With Actions
examples.description: Attach and mode controls sit to the left of submit.

examples.name: With Usage
examples.description: A quota readout sits beside the submit button.
examples.code:
<Prompt onSubmit={(value) => console.log(value)}>
  <Prompt.Textarea />
  <Prompt.Toolbar>
    <Prompt.Actions>
      <Prompt.ActionButton aria-label="Add attachment">
        +
      </Prompt.ActionButton>
      <Prompt.ModeButton active>Auto</Prompt.ModeButton>
    </Prompt.Actions>
    <Prompt.Info>
      <Prompt.Usage>52% used</Prompt.Usage>
      <Prompt.Submit />
    </Prompt.Info>
  </Prompt.Toolbar>
</Prompt>

examples.name: Agent Composer
examples.description: Controls float on the writing surface instead of a footer.
examples.code:
<Prompt
  appearance="seamless"
  submitOnEnter={false}
  minRows={3}
  onSubmit={(value) => console.log(value)}
>
  <Prompt.Textarea placeholder="What should be true when this is done?" />
  <Prompt.Toolbar>
    <Prompt.Actions>
      <Prompt.Select
        aria-label="Model"
        defaultValue="claude-opus-4-8"
        options={[{ value: 'claude-opus-4-8', label: 'Opus 4.8' }, { value: 'claude-sonnet-5', label: 'Sonnet 5' }]}
      />
      <Prompt.ModeButton>Plan</Prompt.ModeButton>
    </Prompt.Actions>
    <Prompt.Info>
      <Prompt.Submit />
    </Prompt.Info>
  </Prompt.Toolbar>
</Prompt>

examples.name: With Attachments
examples.description: Staged files list above the text they belong to.
examples.code:
<Prompt onSubmit={(value) => console.log(value)}>
  <Prompt.Attachments
    items={[
      { id: '1', name: 'findings-export.csv', size: 20480 },
      { id: '2', name: 'dashboard.png', size: 153600 },
    ]}
    onRemove={(id) => console.log(id)}
  />
  <Prompt.Textarea />
  <Prompt.Toolbar>
    <Prompt.Actions>
      <Prompt.ActionButton aria-label="Add attachment">
        +
      </Prompt.ActionButton>
    </Prompt.Actions>
    <Prompt.Info>
      <Prompt.Submit />
    </Prompt.Info>
  </Prompt.Toolbar>
</Prompt>

examples.name: Loading State
examples.description: Input locks and submit spins while the request runs.
examples.code:
<Prompt
  onSubmit={(value) => console.log(value)}
  loading
  defaultValue="Tell me about the weather..."
>
  <Prompt.Textarea />
  <Prompt.Toolbar>
    <Prompt.Actions>
      <Prompt.ActionButton aria-label="Add attachment">
        +
      </Prompt.ActionButton>
      <Prompt.ModeButton>Auto</Prompt.ModeButton>
    </Prompt.Actions>
    <Prompt.Info>
      <Prompt.Usage>52% used</Prompt.Usage>
      <Prompt.Submit />
    </Prompt.Info>
  </Prompt.Toolbar>
</Prompt>

examples.name: Disabled
examples.description: Everything dims and stops responding to input.

relations.note: Use Input for simple single-line text input
Use Textarea for multi-line without toolbar

propsSummary: placeholder: string - hint text (default: "Ask, Search or Chat...")
submitOnEnter: boolean - Enter key behavior (default: true)
Prompt.Textarea accepts native textarea props and optional aria-label override
